question_evidence_quote: John has taken 10 pictures every day for the past 3 years.
observed_error: The written product 10 × 365 × 3 is evaluated as 109,500 instead of 10,950 pictures.
violated_condition: Total pictures must equal the daily picture count multiplied by the number of days over three years.
error_description: The response correctly sets up 10 pictures per day × 365 days per year × 3 years, but evaluates that product as 109,500 pictures instead of 10,950. This arithmetic error inflates the picture total tenfold; the subsequent card count and cost propagate that same error.
